name: Busa Homework Coach
description: Busa Homework Coach: a child-friendly homework desk — questions the agent explained (with the gentle step-by-step explanation), the mistake notebook, practice papers, the parent/teacher review queue, and sanitized settings

agentPrompts.label: Explain a homework question
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-homework-coach` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then explain the question from the photo or pasted text the student gives you, and record the question (plus a mistake card and a matching review entry if the answer was wrong) so a parent or teacher can review it in the app.

agentPrompts.label: What needs parent/teacher review right now?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-homework-coach` skill in this folder, then summarize what is waiting in the parent/teacher review queue across questions, mistakes, and papers, so they know what to look at first.

agentPrompts.label: Execute my approved review decisions
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-homework-coach` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run the decision-execution step for every review I have decided on, and report the local-only follow-up action for each (such as add_to_mistake_book, mark_understood, queue_practice_paper, or export_paper_plan). This never exports, files, or sends anything outside this app.
